biotools.summary: The Good Statistical Monitoring (gsm) R package is an open-source tool designed to proactively monitor risks in clinical trials, supporting risk-based quality management. It provides a flexible framework for statistical data monitoring and facilitates the creation of standardized reports and interactive visualizations.
